fullRoute: 0–3: Clean central ground wall and existing IAS/curved facade; roofs retained in aerial; TNT cut visible. Baked source colours remain on paving/roof, without new periodic wall stripes.
4–7: Central promenade, UYA/source-study lane and IAS exterior remain intact; no new wall triangles or bands. Source-image colour seams and coarse distant structures remain.
8–13: UYA north, former Mensa retaining/terrace, paving, warehouse and asphalt views retain their geometry and materials. Terrace wall looks clean; source ground stains and soft transitions remain.

14–19: Telefonzentrale and COS walls, stepped roofs, timber pattern, paving, benches and planting-bed geometry retained. White facade clean; no regression from grazing treatment. Distant untreated roofs/walls remain coarse.
20–25: COS north paving and GRS north/west/tower/courtyard connectors retain clean panels, glazing and geometry; aerial roof surfaces unchanged. Fine texture and source-colour limitations remain.
26–31: GRS II/III facades, louvers and rounded tower remain clean with intact connector details. Existing tree occlusion and source ground patches remain; no new shadow banding.
32–37: GRS roof/courtyard geometry retained; promenade/crosspaths intact. Prior periodic striping on the close central concrete wall is absent; photographic ground colours still uneven.

38–41: Northern crossing and Galileo court/steps intact. Full-resolution court-floor comparison confirms the rejected candidate’s vertical bands are gone; concrete grain continuous and floor shadows retained. Handrails and stair geometry remain visible.

42–47: Galileo metal/glass modules and campus reflections intact in west/south/east/north views; aerial roofs and western grade retained. No new vertical bands on court walls; baked frontage colours remain.

48–53: Western grade and both ramps intact; retaining walls show continuous concrete texture without the prior vertical shadow bands. MLZ north and lane panels clean; recesses/joints remain visible. Existing thin-line aliasing and coarse distant workshops remain.

54–56: MLZ southern/eastern walls clean without periodic bands; recessed openings and stepped roofs retained. Thin joint aliasing and adjacent coarse workshop roof remain; aerial campus layout intact.
focused: 0–5: Siemensbau walls clean; north-east and west study cameras obstructed by adjacent structures, as previously qualified. Southern trees occlude upper wall. Neighbouring RCM remains conspicuously folded and is the next reconstruction target.

6–13: surveyed roof/context intact; all close wall panels, door/window recesses, sill geometry and narrow-gap views clean. Thin sill edge aliasing persists; coarse neighbouring walls and baked ground imagery remain.

qualifications: Survey envelope and roof are preserved; opening dimensions, recesses, end details and obscured facade rhythm are explicitly estimated in the source specification.
Two context viewpoints are obstructed by adjacent buildings; the inspection also includes closer gap and oblique target views.
Minor thin-sill shadow aliasing remains. The grazing-angle shadow attenuation is approximate and static captures do not establish temporal stability at every sun angle.
Source imagery still contains baked lighting/colour and coarse untreated adjacent structures. No interiors are reconstructed.
Original and preview saves/settings are preserved separately during installation.
